title: Illusionist / 幻术师
description:
A standalone mirror-and-illusion character for Slay the Spire 2, with three coupled systems:

- Mirror: "Copy" summons mirror images that replay your first card each turn and shatter when you take unblocked damage.
- Intent: read and reflect enemy telegraphs (Counter, Foresight, Provoke).
- Transmute: temporarily reshape your own cards (Shifting Blade, Myriad Faces, Phantom Blast), with a transmute stack that unwinds one layer per turn.

~40 themed cards, custom relics and potions, a starter relic, and Orobas (Ancient) relic/card upgrades.

Fully localized in English and 简体中文.
changeNote: v0.4.3 - Card-pool fixes. Fixed a bug (thanks for the report!) where token cards that are only ever created by other cards - Prescience (先见), Dim Lamp (暗淡油灯) and Extinguished Lamp (熄灭油灯) - could be offered as normal card rewards; they now live in a separate non-reward pool. Reversal has been pulled from the regular card pool (reclassified as an Ancient card) because its interaction with Mirror Image scaled without limit. Builds on v0.4.2, which required Slay the Spire 2 v0.108.0 + the RitsuLib base mod, restored the combat portrait, fixed Extract/Sacrifice not ending the Mirror Image echo, added Hall of Mirrors, and ran a balance pass. English & 简体中文.
